name: Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd. provides container transport, shipping, and shipping logistic services. It offers choice networks, individual services, vessel information, and container management services; specialized services; and e-commerce services. The company Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd. was founded in 1983 and is based in Shanghai, China. Shanghai Jinjiang Shipping (Group) Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Shanghai International Port (Group) Co., Ltd.
